authorities.payment: signed Stripe checkout.session.completed with livemode=false, amount_total=3900, currency=eur
authorities.delivery: operator-approved Resend send only after the persisted fulfillment gate

deploymentOrder: Create or select one isolated Convex TEST-A deployment; set CUSTOMER_FLOW_BACKEND_TOKEN in Convex without exposing its value.
Run npx convex deploy against that exact test deployment and record its deployment URL.
Install only the Vercel API runtime variables listed in vercelApi.environmentVariables, then create a new preview deployment.
Probe /api/customer-flow/health and an invalid webhook signature; do not open the landing route yet.
Create exactly one Stripe test-mode webhook endpoint for the canonical URL and accepted event.
Install STRIPE_CUSTOMER_FLOW_WEBHOOK_SECRET in Vercel, redeploy, and verify the active preview was built after the secret update.
Run one unique synthetic intake with delivered@resend.dev or an .example.test address, one Stripe test Checkout event, and an exact duplicate replay.
Query Convex directly for one customer job, one fulfillment aggregate, and one provider event; verify the fulfillment state is generation_queued.
Keep generation, publication, and delivery closed until a human review decision is persisted.
Install RESEND_API_KEY and RESEND_FROM only in the operator delivery runtime, never in the public Vercel API runtime.
After operator approval and a test Vercel publication receipt, send only to Resend's documented test sink and reconcile the provider message status.
Complete landing compatibility task t_b5ed0ad9, then independently review the exact app and landing SHAs before changing the landing API base URL.

vercelApi.testAccess: X-Test-A-Access-Token is required on every /v1 command and must be collected interactively, held in memory only, and never bundled into browser assets

stripe.signedBusinessMismatch: persist a redacted payload fingerprint and reason code, then acknowledge without advancing the job

resendOperatorRuntime.idempotencySafety: send only while the persisted delivery attempt is younger than 23 hours

rollback: Restore the landing API base URL to its previous value or unset it.
Disable the single Stripe test webhook endpoint.
Remove the Vercel preview alias; preserve the deployment for audit until rollback is accepted.
Revoke the Vercel-scoped Convex backend token and Resend operator key.
Preserve Convex event and job records; do not delete evidence during rollback.
